Nina Gomez: Quick ping 1: All-hands tomorrow 9:00 PT / 17:00 CET. Agenda: 1) CEO update on product-market fit signals (8m), 2) Launch callouts for v2 routing and rollout checklist (Omid, 12m), 3) Privacy policy clarification re: customer telemetry (Ruth, 6m), 4) Short customer success story (Marcus, 4m), 5) Q&A (10m). Please add Qs here or to the form: https://forms.redwood/allhands-qs. Recording on, captions enabled.
Omid Farahani: For launch callouts, Ill cover canary plan, rollback thresholds, and recommended observability checks. Requesting SRE to confirm the default health window.
Nina Gomez: @SRE team please confirm health window. Also presenters upload slides to https://repo.redwood/allhands-deck by EOD.
Ruth (Privacy): We'll clarify telemetry retention windows and anonymization steps. No change to PII handling, just clarification of retention defaults for Hosted.
Marcus: Short add: can we pin the launch checklist in the product channel after the all-hands?
LaunchBot: Reminder: add your deck to #deck-submissions by 5pm today.
--post meeting--
Nina Gomez: Recording + transcript: https://video.redwood/recs/2198765432. Takeaways: CEO emphasizes product-market fit cohorts and support for PLG growth, v2 routing rollout plan with clear canary/rollback thresholds, privacy clarifications on telemetry retention. Actions: Omid to publish rollout checklist (due Tue), Ruth to publish privacy FAQ (due Fri), SRE to confirm health window and publish runbook (due Mon).
